## Overview

The AIAA/ASME Joint Thermophysics and Heat Transfer Conference, held within the AIAA AVIATION Forum, covers thermophysics and heat transfer in aerospace: thermal protection systems, ablation, aerothermal environments, surface radiation. Emissivity of high-temperature aerospace materials is directly relevant.
